posting_text:
Robotics Mechanical Engineer @ Kestrel Robotics 🤖
San Francisco · On-site · Series B

Hey! We build autonomous picking arms for grocery warehouses. We ship weekly, argue kindly, and celebrate every first pick.

🚀 What you'll do
- Design end effectors and gearbox housings in SolidWorks
- Run FEA on arm links and iterate with topology optimization
- Bring up new hardware with our ROS2 software team

💪 What we're looking for
- 3+ years designing electromechanical assemblies
- Strong SolidWorks skills and solid GD&T fundamentals
- Experience with sheet metal and machined parts, plus a DFM/DFA mindset

✨ Bonus points
- Experience with FANUC or other industrial robot programming
- C++ or Python for test scripts

🎁 Perks
- Equity, 401k match, and lunch every day
- Quarterly hack week where people try 3D printing, CFD or whatever they like
- Free Fusion 360 and MATLAB licenses for side projects

🌈 Our Values
- Ship it, then make it better
- No ego, no blame
- Friday demos where anyone can show off a CNC side project
